newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA reported. Inquiry was moderate and demand light.
Sales confirmed for the week to date on 4,200 cattle, mostly previously contracted or formalated cattle. Bids at $65.00 to mostly $66.00 per cwt, with asking prices $68.00-$69.00, few $70.00.
Last price $67.00 paid Thursday, April 24. Sales FOB
feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed: none last week: 37,900 last year: none
Wk to date: 4,200 last week: 42,400 last year: 4,100
